pages.scope: Ambient ZF; L carries its canonical well-order and internal AC. Finite HF traces, truth tables, and bounded histories now supply the weak-level absoluteness needed for condensation at every nonzero limit, including L_omega without Infinity. GCH is internal to L. Diamond is stationary guessing on omega_1. The Suslin corollary explicitly uses AC from V=L. The separate formal-transfer tail still needs verified proof constructors, not a full-CTM assumption.

pages.authoring_notes: The finite-history supplier, arbitrary-limit condensation, subset-stage theorem, internal GCH theorem, V=L-to-diamond theorem, Suslin corollary, constructible-real example, conditional antichain-sealing example, and formal proof-transfer tail are authored. The supplier uses total Enum traces, an exact two-branch Decode relation, fixed stage bounds, and a separate L_omega/no-Infinity argument. The formal tail supplies a mathematical primitive-recursive proof-schema compiler and PA-verification induction; executable encoding tests remain regression evidence rather than a claimed PA proof object.

pages.scope: Stronger conditions are ordered below weaker ones. Atomic forcing is a well-founded name-rank recursion; formula forcing uses dense witnesses. The ZF extension proof is choice-free, while preservation of AC explicitly uses ground-model AC. Semantic CTM forcing remains conditional; only finite-fragment/proof translation licenses formal consistency conclusions. Boolean completion is the ZF regular-open completion and excludes zero.
